{{Quote|I have asked the Jedi council to allow me to fight with you. They have agreed on the condition that you create a fortress.|Qui-Gon Jinn to the Wookiees|audio=Qui-GonFortress.flac|<ref name="GB" />}}
A '''base''' was built by [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] [[Alaris Prime colonists|colonists]] on the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Alaris Prime/Legends|Alaris Prime]] between [[39 BBY/Legends|39]] and [[36 BBY/Legends|36 BBY]]. It was constructed south of a [[Unidentified Trade Federation base|base]] belonging to the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]], an organization the Wookiees were at [[Alaris Prime colonial war|war]] with. The buildings inside the base were constructed and used by Wookiee workers, while parts of its outer walls were constructed by the Wookiee [[Shoran]]. At the base, the leader of the [[Colonist/Legends|colonists]], [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]], planned an [[Battle for Alaris Prime|assault]] on the Trade Federation base, intending to drive them from Alaris Prime.

The [[Sentry tower/Legends|sentry posts]] constructed around the base were attacked by [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droids]] on the orders of Trade Federation [[Commanding officer/Legends|commander]] [[SRAM-13]]. A [[Fortress/Legends|fortress]] was built in the base at the request of the [[Jedi High Council/Legends|Jedi Council]] to allow the Wookiee's [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Advisor/Legends|advisor]], [[Qui-Gon Jinn/Legends|Qui-Gon Jinn]], to land at the base and participate in the battle. The base was also [[Scout/Legends|scouted]] by [[Vulture-class starfighter/Legends|light droid starfighters]] sent by SRAM-13, and the Wookiees at the base later assembled an [[Army/Legends|army]] with which they successfully attacked the Trade Federation base.

==Description==
{{Quote|Shoran has helped us wall off the camp, but we must complete the job.|Qui-Gon Jinn|audio=ShoranWalls.flac|<ref name="GB" />}}
The base was one of several built by workers of the [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] [[Species/Legends|species]] on the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Alaris Prime/Legends|Alaris Prime]]. It was constructed north of a wide [[Forest/Legends|forest]] that covered the eastern side and south of a [[Water/Legends|river]] that flowed from the northwest down to the western edge of the base. The [[command center]] of the base was surrounded by four [[Farm/Legends|farms]], a [[food processing center]], and a clump of [[Tree/Legends|trees]]. The command center was surrounded by a ring consisting of, in clockwise order from the north, a [[prefab shelter]], a [[carbon processing center]], a [[Barracks/Legends|troop center]], a [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceport]], another prefab shelter, a [[Power core/Legends|power core]], a mech [[Factory/Legends|factory]], four more prefab shelters, and an [[animal nursery]]. Two [[Sentry tower/Legends|sentry posts]] were built inside the base, one southwest of the base's center and another in the northeast.<ref name="GB" />

[[File:Final_base_outer_walls.png|thumb|right|300px|The outer walls of the base with their builder, Shoran (bottom right)]]
The Wookiee [[Shoran]] partially built several stretches of walls that covered areas of the base not protected by the treeline, and they stood some distance from the rest of the buildings. To the north of the base, five sentry posts were built to alert the Wookiees of any incoming attacks from the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]], who had a [[Unidentified Trade Federation base|base]] north of the river.<ref name="GB" /> The river acted as a natural barrier between the two settlements.<ref name="Prima">[[Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds: Prima's Official Strategy Guide|''Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds'': Prima's Official Strategy Guide]]</ref>

To the northeast of the base, a hidden path through the forest led to an [[ancient grove]] associated with the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]]. The Wookiee base was significantly expanded on the recommendations of [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Qui-Gon Jinn/Legends|Qui-Gon Jinn]], an [[Advisor/Legends|advisor]] to the Wookiees. The workers completed the walls and built a [[Fortress/Legends|fortress]]<ref name="GB" /> along with an [[Airbase/Legends|airbase]] and a heavy weapons factory.<ref name="Prima" /> Jinn also recommended that the Wookiees construct a [[War Center]] to research upgrades to their military arsenal. The base was abundant in natural resources, with various [[Muja fruit/Legends|muja fruit]] [[Bush/Legends|bushes]] growing in the center along with deposits of [[Nova crystal/Legends|nova crystals]] and [[Ore/Legends|ore]]. Several [[Nerf/Legends|nerfs]] also lived in the base.<ref name="GB" />

==History==
{{Quote|Good, you have a fortress. I shall arrive shortly.|Qui-Gon Jinn to the Wookiees|audio=GoodFortress.flac|<ref name="GB" />}}
[[File:SRAM-13s_droids.png|thumb|left|200px|Battle droids attack the base's outer sentry posts.]]
The base was constructed between [[39 BBY/Legends|39 BBY]] and [[36 BBY/Legends|36 BBY]]<ref name="NEC" /> during the [[Alaris Prime colonial war|war]] for Alaris Prime fought between the [[Alaris Prime colonization resolution|legitimate]] Wookiee [[Alaris Prime colonists|colonists]] and the Trade Federation. The Wookiees positioned themselves near the Trade Federation's main base in preparation to permanently remove them from the moon in the [[Battle for Alaris Prime]]. The Wookiee leader [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]] was advised by Jinn to destroy the Trade Federation's fortress in order to expel them. The initial Wookiees at the base included Chewbacca, Shoran, eight workers, seven [[bowcaster trooper]]s, two [[HummBike]] [[Speeder bike/Legends|speeder]] riders, and two [[dragon trooper]]s. Jinn informed the Wookiees that the [[Jedi High Council/Legends|Jedi Council]] had given permission for him to participate in the battle personally if the Wookiees built a fortress. Chewbacca set the workers to gather resources in order to upgrade their [[Technology level|level of technology]], allowing them to build such a fortress.<ref name="GB" />

Chewbacca's [[Gender/Legends|father]], [[Attichitcuk/Legends|Attichitcuk]], also arrived at the base to participate in the battle, having finally recovered from wounds [[Ambush of Attichitcuk|inflicted]] on him by the Trade Federation. A group of [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droids]], including a [[Droideka/Legends|droideka]] and five [[B1-series battle droid/Legends|beetle droids]], were sent by the Trade Federation [[Commanding officer/Legends|commander]] [[SRAM-13]] to attack the outer sentry posts. Jinn instructed the workers to complete the gaps in the walls built by Shoran, reminding them to build gates to avoid trapping themselves in their own base. The Wookiees gathered enough resources to improve their technological level and construct a fortress, after which Jinn arrived at the base in a [[Naboo Royal Lifter]].<ref name="GB" />

[[File:Fed_scouts.png|thumb|right|300px|Three light droid starfighters scouted the base.]]
At that point, SRAM-13 sent a trio of [[Vulture-class starfighter/Legends|light droid starfighters]] to [[Scout/Legends|scout]] the base. Jinn warned the Wookiees to prepare for an attack, but as the droids turned out to be scouts, the base remained safe. The Jedi told the Wookiees to prepare anti-air defenses, including [[Turret/Legends|turrets]] and an airbase, with which they could build [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighters]].<ref name="GB" /> The Wookiees also built a heavy weapons factory and gathered an [[Army/Legends|army]] of ten [[Agr (starfighter)|Agr]] starfighters, three [[Blade bomber|Heavy Blade]] [[Bomber/Legends|bombers]], three [[Energy pummel/Legends|energy pummels]], five [[Sentinel (Wookiees)|sentinel]] mechs, and five heavy bowcaster troopers. The Wookiee leadership and Jinn then stormed the Trade Federation base and destroyed their fortress.<ref name="Prima" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Wookiee base was first mentioned in [[Prima Games]]' [[Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds: Prima's Official Strategy Guide|strategy guide]] by [[Steven L. Kent]],<ref name="Prima">[[Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds: Prima's Official Strategy Guide|''Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds'': Prima's Official Strategy Guide]]</ref> released on [[November 7]], [[2001]],<ref name="PrimaDate">{{Amazon|url=Star-Wars-Galactic-Battlegrounds-Official/dp/0761537503|text=Star Wars Galactic Battlegrounds: Prima's Official Strategy Guide}}</ref> for the [[LucasArts]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds]]'', which was released on [[November 11]], 2001.<ref name="GBDate">{{GameSpot|url=games/star-wars-galactic-battlegrounds|text=Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds}}</ref> The base appears in the seventh and final level of the tutorial campaign, entitled "The Battle for Alaris Prime." In the level, the player has control of the layout of their base and which buildings to construct, with the game providing access to every building type except for [[Jedi temple/Legends|Jedi Temples]] and [[monument]]s.<ref name="GB" />

The strategy guide suggests that an especially cautious player could expand the boundaries of the base by destroying the existing walls and building new ones further out. Alternatively, the guide suggests that the player could place troopers in an area they wish to control and then send workers in to build turrets. It also states that the player starts the level in tech level 1;<ref name="Prima" /> however, in the game the player begins in tech level 2.<ref name="GB" />
